intro: Hostages. A stolen top-secret project "WARHEAD". You're the only one going in. Warhead Vanguard is a hardcore tactical TPS with next-gen 3D physics!
description:
From a mountain ambush and a night raid in a border city, to storming an armed stronghold on the Caspian coast and a final push into an underground ICBM silo. Warhead Vanguard puts suffocating tension and full tactical freedom in your hands. Armed militants have crossed the border and seized missiles that were supposed to be long decommissioned. Sending in conventional forces is off the table. Diplomacy has failed. There is nothing left to negotiate. You are the last option.

・Brand-new 3D physics engine with real-time reactions to destruction, ballistics and impact!
・Next-generation shaders deliver cinematic-quality rendering of metal, fabric, dust and steel surfaces!
・Story-driven missions with clear, real-world-style objectives for every operation!
・Go in loud, go in quiet or call in fire support with total freedom to choose your approach!
・Full loadout customisation with weapons, optics, suppressors and tactical gear combinations!
・Four massive combat zones covering mountain terrain, a border city, a Caspian industrial port and an underground ICBM silo!
・Engine optimisation keeps the frame rate rock-solid through massive enemy encounters and explosive set pieces!

Warhead Vanguard was designed and built from day one to deliver hard-hitting action. A physics environment that reacts instantly to everything you do, visuals pulled straight from a blockbuster film, and mission design that punishes every mistake. When all three lock together, you are the operator. The mission clock is ticking. Get in there now.

Prologue
A government convoy is ambushed deep in a mountain range near the border. RPG and machine gun fire hit simultaneously, and the attackers take out the lead and rear vehicles first to seal off any escape. When the shooting stops, they strip the convoy of its military hardware and a classified project known only as "WARHEAD", then disappear across the border. The whole thing is over in under ten minutes. By the time reinforcements show up, there is nothing left but burning wreckage.

Days later, some of the stolen gear turns up on the black market. Equipment that should never have been accessible to any militia. Not long after, government vehicles start getting hit all across the border city. Checkpoints are attacked every night. Patrol units vanish without a trace. Then a video drops showing a government officer being taken captive, and word comes in that a strategically critical port on the Caspian coast has fallen to the armed group. Buried under that territory are ICBM silos that were supposed to have been taken offline years ago, along with a nuclear fuel reprocessing facility that could bring them back up to full operational status.

Intelligence moves to lock down the area, but it is already too late. Drone footage shows armed vehicles rolling into the facility in a steady stream. Mercenaries, insurgents and smuggling networks pour in together, and the entire zone turns into a fortified stronghold almost overnight. Sending in a conventional force is not an option given the global political situation. There is only one play left. Insert a small special operations team to pull out the hostages, take down the leadership and recover "WARHEAD". In the dark, the operators start moving.
